item.title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size

turns.text: I need matching plant-shop ads in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design.

item.tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

style.prompt: Create a polished square plant-shop sale advertisement, designed as the master of a coordinated three-format campaign. Clean green-and-cream graphic design: warm cream background #F6F2E7, deep forest-green typography #174B35, subtle sage accents. Lush realistic leafy indoor plants including ferns and monstera arranged around the lower corners and edges, leaving generous uncluttered space for text. Sophisticated bold highly legible sans-serif typography, restrained botanical retail editorial style. Render ONLY the following five exact text lines, no additional words: 'Fern House'; 'Weekend Plant Sale'; '20% off all indoor plants'; 'Saturday & Sunday'; 'Visit 24 Willow Lane'. Use title case and punctuation exactly as supplied. Hierarchy: brand at top, large bold sale headline at upper middle, strong clear discount beneath, day line below. The COMPLETE address 'Visit 24 Willow Lane' must be prominent, bold, comfortably readable in a spacious cream footer, not small print, not obscured by foliage. All five lines must be easy to read, high contrast, correctly spelled, comfortably inside safe margins. Square layout balanced for 1:1, text is the primary content, plants frame rather than compete.
